## Problem

Three predicate copies of `git -C <worktree> status --porcelain` decide worktree dirtiness with different failure defaults, on purpose and documented: `src/lib/workflow/worktree-manager.ts:399` returns `true` on a git failure (the cleanup guard at :469 keeps an unknown worktree, #935); `src/lib/workflow/run-orchestrator.ts:99` returns `false` (the chain-resume resolver contract at `chain-resume.ts:77-80` says a missing worktree is the branch-tip check's case, #760); `checkWorktreeFreshness` at `worktree-manager.ts:301` leaves its flag false on failure. A boolean must lie in one direction: today the shutdown log at :502 prints "preserved (uncommitted changes): <path>" when the status was merely unreadable, including for a path that no longer exists. A fourth hand-copied check lives in `chain-resume.integration.test.ts:105-112`. Separately, `formatSignalLine` is an identical switch in `commands/locks.ts:18` and `run-orchestrator.ts:49`, except a two-space indent and one shortened message.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC-1: One `worktreeStatus(path): "clean" | "dirty" | "unknown"` in `worktree-manager.ts` is the only predicate spawn of `git status --porcelain` in `src/lib/workflow`; the three porcelain parsers (`worktree-manager.ts` checkpoint `-z`, `phase-executor.ts` `--untracked-files=all`, `qa-stagnation.ts`) are untouched. Evidence: `rg -n '"status", "--porcelain"\]' src/lib/workflow -g '!*.test.ts' | wc -l` → `1` (3 today: `run-orchestrator.ts:102`, `worktree-manager.ts:303`, `:402`).
- [ ] AC-2: The primitive is truthful on real git: clean and dirty worktrees, a non-existent path, an existing non-repo directory, and a worktree whose admin dir was removed. Evidence: `npx vitest run src/lib/workflow/worktree-manager.test.ts -t "worktreeStatus"` → ≥ 5 passed, 0 failed (`index.lock` held still reads clean/dirty, exit 0; the three failure cases read `unknown`); mutation-verified: mapping a non-zero exit to `clean` makes `src/lib/workflow/worktree-manager.test.ts > worktreeStatus > a non-existent path is unknown` fail.
- [ ] AC-3: Each caller keeps its documented default (D-1b): `worktreePreserveReason` preserves on `unknown` with a reason that is not "uncommitted changes"; the chain-resume resolver treats `unknown` as not dirty and resumes on the branch tip. Evidence: `npx vitest run src/lib/workflow/worktree-manager.test.ts src/lib/workflow/chain-resume.integration.test.ts -t "unknown|nonexistent|gone"` → ≥ 2 passed, 0 failed (`worktreePreserveReason(abort, "/nonexistent")` is non-null and not "uncommitted changes"; a `ready_for_merge` link whose worktree dir is removed but branch intact resumes without `failFast`, using the real primitive instead of the hand copy).
- [ ] AC-4: One `formatSignalLine(issue, pid, result, { indent })` produces the `locks` lines unindented and the orchestrator lines with the two-space indent, with one message text per reason. Evidence: `npx vitest run src/lib/locks/signal-line.test.ts` → ≥ 2 passed, 0 failed (new file beside the new export).
- [ ] AC-5: The detector no longer reports the two names on this branch (must run against the real dependency). Evidence: `ACCRETION_HOME=$(mktemp -d) node ~/Projects/accretion-audit/dist/cli.js dups --repo "$PWD" --json | node -e "let s='';process.stdin.on('data',d=>s+=d).on('end',()=>{const n=new Set(JSON.parse(s).groups.map(g=>g.name));const hit=['isWorktreeDirty','formatSignalLine'].filter(x=>n.has(x));console.log(hit.join(',')||'none');process.exit(hit.length?1:0)})"` → `none`, exit 0.

## Prior fixes / producers

- `isWorktreeDirty`: #760 (orchestrator copy, chain resume), #935 (signal shutdown). Two producers of one git call with opposite, documented failure defaults; D-1b keeps both defaults at the call sites and shares only the primitive. Neither default is pinned by a test today (`worktree-manager.test.ts:652-677` use readable worktrees only). No owner gate.
- `formatSignalLine`: #637 only. Two producers of the same text.
- `run-orchestrator.ts` already imports from `worktree-manager.ts` (:31-39) and `chain-resume.ts` imports only `completed-status`, so the shared primitive adds no cycle; the boolean `CompletedLinkResolver` interface (`chain-resume.ts:81`) and its unit stubs stay as they are.

## May touch

`src/lib/workflow/worktree-manager.ts`, `src/lib/workflow/run-orchestrator.ts`, `src/lib/workflow/chain-resume.integration.test.ts`, `src/lib/locks/` (one new export beside `signalOther`), `src/commands/locks.ts`, their tests, the changelog entry. Serialize after #1473 (`commands/locks.ts`).

## Non-Goals

- Changing any caller's default for `unknown`, or the chain-resume contract.
- The three porcelain parsers named in AC-1.
- Any edit under `plugin/`, `.claude/skills/` or `templates/skills/` (I-1).
